name: Agent Skills (SKILL.md)
summary: An open format for packaging agent capabilities as folders, each with a SKILL.md file holding YAML frontmatter and Markdown instructions, plus optional scripts, references and assets. Agents load only each skill's name and description at startup and read the full instructions when a task matches. Originally developed by Anthropic and published as an open standard in December 2025.
facts: Anthropic, opened as a standard on 2025-12-18
Metadata at startup, body on activation, files on demand
SKILL.md under 500 lines, body under ~5,000 tokens
goodFor: Skills that work across several agent products
Keeping many capabilities available at low context cost
watchOut: Spec is short; some fields are loosely defined
Clients add their own frontmatter fields that do not port
Skills can bundle code; audit before installing
